name: Hotfix v1.12.1.3
notes:
## Bug Fixes

### Gameplay
- The game will not crash when recalling Dondozo and Tatsugiri before a fixed battle or biome change.
- Life dew no longer fails if only one target in doubles is at full HP.
- Salt Cure's damage over time effect will deal 1/16 max HP in damage (1/8 vs Water and Steel types) per turn again, matching the balance change from Champions.

### UI/UX
- Shiny icons will not be covered by the background in the starter select screen when using the legacy UI.
- When selecting the random button, starter icons will not start jumping.
- When leaving the starter select menu while on the random button, then opening the menu again, the cursor will be correctly reset.
- Renaming a Pokémon from the party icons will apply to the starter.
- Pokémon such as Zygarde, which may not have their base form unlocked when caught, will correctly have the first caught form as their default in the Starter Select screen.
- Candy upgrade animations will work again.

name: Hotfix v1.12.1.2
notes:
## Bug Fixes
- When fainting an enemy with a frenzy move like Outrage, the next turn the move will still execute properly. This may not fix the issue when transitioning from a doubles battle wave to a singles battle wave in some cases however.
  - Saves that were broken due to this issue should also be fixed.
- It is again possible to change starter preferences while selecting a starter in the party.
- Rival team generation will properly consider both types of each of the rival's Pokémon when balancing weaknesses.
- Fixed an issue where choosing the "Give it Food" option in Uncommon Breed would result in the mon having two of the same egg move in its moveset instead of two different ones
- After a game over during a trainer battle, that trainer no longer stays on the field in the next run, where it could show up in later battles (including wild ones).

## Balance
- Toedscool now gets Muddy Water as an Egg Move over Topsy Turvy.
- Espeon now learns Safeguard from Pokemon Champions at Level 23.
- Croagunk and Toxicroak now learn Close Combat from Legends Arceus at Level 52 and 60, respectively.
- Probopass now learns Flash Cannon from Legends Arceus via Memory Mushroom.
- Skiddo and Gogoat now learn Megahorn from Legends ZA at Level 54 and 65, respectively. Earthquake was moved down to Level 60 from 66 as in older generations.
- Nickit and Thievul now learn Roar from Legends ZA at Level 10.
- Enemy Giratina should no longer generate Phantom Force over Shadow Force.

name: Hotfix v1.12.1.1
notes:
## Bug Fixes
- Fixed a game over that could happen after winning a singles battle when only one party member could still fight and the next wave in the same biome was a double battle.
- Fixed a soft lock where the game got stuck after winning a battle instead of opening the reward shop if 2 or more eggs hatched on the same wave with Egg Skip set to "Never".
- Hatched eggs will no longer show randomized abilities when hatched during an active Ability Randomizer challenge.

name: Minor Update v1.12.1.0
notes:
## General
- Added the Moveset Randomizer challenge
  - Level-up learnsets are randomized per base species and move ID combination. This means for example that the move Ember from Charmander's level up moveset will be randomized to the same move as the Ember from Charmeleon's level up moveset
  - TM compatibility is randomized, but the number of learnable TMs for each Pokémon remains the same
  - Egg moves are disabled
  - More specific details to come (or be discovered!)
- Added the Ability Randomizer challenge
  - Each species' ability (and optionally passive) is randomized
  - Abilities are randomized per species + ability combination. If a species has multiple forms with the same ability (e.g. Magearna and Mega Magearna), both forms will have the same randomized ability. The same applies to passives
  - Form change and negative abilities are not included in the randomized pool
  - Comes with a "Lite" mode, which allows Pokémon with form change abilities to retain their abilities
- Added an option to forget moves through the Summary screen during the reward selection phase
- Trace works as a passive ability, copying the opponent's passive (or primary if their passive is not enabled) into the user's passive slot
- Added an option to switch party order during the reward selection phase
- New music tracks added: Construction Site (by cello) and Swamp (by Faces in the Clouds)

## Memory / Performance
- Added a setting to fully disable audio
  - This entirely prevents audio from being loaded into memory, so we recommend enabling it if you see performance/refresh issues
- Added a menu option allowing users to clear local data without manually clearing the browser's cache

## Balance
- Passive Changes for 10 Species/Forms, or 9 Evolution Lines
- Egg Move Changes for 20 Starters
- Added a new path out from the Laboratory biome to Island. 50/50 without Map, both Construction Site and Island will always be available with the Map
- Rules for randomization challenges:
  - Randomization is hidden during starter selection to discourage spoilers and re-rolling
  - Other Ribbons and Achievements are disabled when a randomization setting is enabled
- When a wild Pokémon flees or is forced out, the player is given a post-battle shop with no rewards instead of being immediately sent to the next wave
  - If you defeat at least one enemy Pokémon, you will get the normal post-battle rewards, even if the other flees
  - There is no change if the player ends the battle by selecting the "Run" option
- Shinies can no longer appear in the End biome during the Fresh Start challenge
- In the Meadow biome, the Dancing Lessons encounter spawns a random Oricorio form instead of only Pom-Pom
- The Dark Deal Mystery Encounter pool no longer features Battle Bond Greninja, Eternal Floette, and Bloodmoon Ursaluna
- Trainers who use Pokémon of level below 40 won't be given relearn-only moves
- Added a Great tier TM for Dual Chop
- Added a Great tier TM for Night Slash
- Added an Ultra tier TM for First Impression
- Added content and balance changes from Champions Regulation M-C
- No Retreat is no longer continually usable if the user is trapped via a move like Mean Look or Jaw Lock
- Adjusted general trainer strength - most trainer Pokémon now appear at a higher level, except for the aces of Champion teams, which have been slightly reduced
- Made various adjustments to NatDex learnsets
- Edited enemy moveset generation, generally resulting in stronger attacking moves
- Adjusted Uncommon Breed Encounter:
  - The generated egg move now takes the last slot instead of the first, preventing interference with move generation
  - Pre-battle stat changes: changed from Defense, Special Defense, and Speed (along with Attack and Special Attack if above wave 150) to only Defense and Special Defense (along with Speed if above wave 150)
- Grip Claw no longer steals an item if the attack caused the holder to faint (e.g. due to Rough Skin)
- Adjusted the species pools for various trainer classes
- Adjusted Pokémon, move, and ability selection for many high-level trainers (Gym Leaders, Elite 4, Champions, Evil Team leaders/admins)
- Memory Mushroom no longer spawns if no Pokémon in the party can relearn any moves
- Trainers are less likely to generate with duplicate Pokémon

## UI/UX
- Reworked the starter select screen to improve performance and substantially decrease memory use
- Shop/Reward items now render properly even on lower end devices and/or high game speeds
- The challenge menu displays what ribbons would be unlocked before starting the run
- An explanatory message is displayed when the user attempts to login with an unlinked Google or Discord account
- Shop item costs are displayed next to their name in the message box for easier reading
- TM and Level moves in the Pokédex now have icons, similar to the Memory Mushroom menu
- Terapagos now appears with the Stellar tera type in starter select
- Shiny starters can be selected in the Fresh Start challenge, but they do not provide extra Luck
- Trapping effects display their correct Gen 9 messages
- Curse no longer uses the Salt Cure animation
- The name of a selected reward no longer stays on the screen until the next wave
- Fire Spin now has its own text instead of reusing Whirlpool's
- The challenge select menu is now centered properly
- Removed flyouts for Mimicry, Friend Guard, and Parental Bond
- Tabs in the settings navigation bar display properly across all languages
- Fixed the position of the "Growth Rate:" text in starter select and the Pokédex across languages
- Fixed linebreaks for Japanses and Chinese languages
- Event-based sprite replacements for trainers with gender differences are now handled properly
- Added an accessibility option to always require manual clearing of battle messages
- The current language is no longer populated in the language-select menu
- Significantly improved handling of orientation changes on mobile devices
- Moved "Player Gender" and "Pref
